faq.title: Questions business owners usually ask first.

items.q: Is BossIP a chat tool or a business system?
items.a: It is closer to a cloud business assistant that keeps working: you can chat, but it also tracks tasks, source material, and outcomes.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. Describe the goal in plain language. It asks for what's missing and handles the spreadsheets, documents, and web pages itself.

items.q: Can my team use it together?
items.a: Yes. Projects and chats live in a shared workspace. Invite colleagues to share material and split the work.
